dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: Maps a real number s to the matrix indexed by Fin 1 in both coordinates whose every entry equals s, namely the 1 × 1 matrix [s].
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The sole matrix under consideration is [speed].

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a real m × m matrix indexed by Fin m, this abbreviation asserts LocalDef003 of that matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Specializes the existence of a real eigenbasis to the matrix [speed] with m = 1.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a square real matrix A indexed by a finite type ι, there exist a family of real numbers λ indexed by ι and an ι-indexed real basis b of the vector space ι → Real such that A.mulVec(b(p)) = λ(p) • b(p) for every p in ι.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The conclusion requires a complete real basis consisting of eigenvectors of [speed], with an associated real eigenvalue for each basis vector.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The natural-number type, including zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the dimension parameter, fixed to the natural number 1.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the value representing a natural-number literal from its OfNat instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets the explicit dimension literal as an element of Nat.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The universally quantified parameter, matrix entries, eigenvalues, and coordinates of basis vectors are real.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interprets a natural-number literal n in Nat as n itself.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Ensures that the instantiated dimension is exactly 1.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin
dependency_coverage.meaning: Fin n is the type of natural numbers strictly less than n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Fin 1 has the single index 0, so the matrix and its eigenbasis have one index.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.fintype
dependency_coverage.meaning: Provides the exhaustive finite enumeration of Fin n using finRange n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes the coordinate index set finite and supplies the single summation index for multiplication by a 1 × 1 matrix.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix
dependency_coverage.meaning: A matrix with row type m, column type n, and entries in α is a function m → n → α.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The coefficient is a function Fin 1 → Fin 1 → Real, with no additional matrix data or assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: Algebra.id
dependency_coverage.meaning: Gives a commutative semiring its algebra structure over itself, with identity algebra map and scalar multiplication given by multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The underlying real scalar action on real coordinates is ordinary real multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: Algebra.toSMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the scalar multiplication operation from an algebra structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the real scalar action used to form scalar multiples of vector coordinates.

dependency_coverage.name: CommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: Forgets the unit-related structure of a commutative ring while retaining its addition, subtraction, negation, and multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides part of the structure needed for real matrix multiplication without changing the real arithmetic.

dependency_coverage.name: CommSemiring.toSemiring
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the semiring structure from a commutative semiring.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies real semiring operations for the algebra and module structures without adding hypotheses.

dependency_coverage.name: DFunLike.coe
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the underlying dependent function from an object equipped with a DFunLike structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supports treating the basis as a function assigning a vector to each basis index.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: Equality of two elements of the same type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The eigenvector equation is exact equality of vectors, equivalently equality in every coordinate.

dependency_coverage.name: Exists
dependency_coverage.meaning: Existential quantification: there is a witness satisfying the given predicate.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Quantifies first an eigenvalue family and then an eigenbasis; these witnesses may depend on speed, and the basis may be chosen after the eigenvalue family.

dependency_coverage.name: Fintype
dependency_coverage.meaning: A finite-type structure providing an exhaustive finite collection of the type's elements.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Permits finite matrix-vector sums; the relevant structure is the canonical one on Fin 1.

dependency_coverage.name: Function.hasSMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Lifts a scalar action on α to functions ι → α by the pointwise scalar action.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Multiplying a basis vector by its eigenvalue multiplies each real coordinate by that eigenvalue.

dependency_coverage.name: HSMul.hSMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the heterogeneous scalar multiplication operation from its structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Denotes the scalar-vector multiplication on the right side of the eigenvector equation.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.mulVec
dependency_coverage.meaning: Multiplies a matrix M by a coordinate vector v: its coordinate at i is the dot product of row i with v, namely the finite sum of M(i,j)v(j) over j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For [speed], the only coordinate of A.mulVec(v) is speed times v(0).

dependency_coverage.name: Module.Basis
dependency_coverage.meaning: An indexed basis of an R-module M, consisting of linearly independent vectors spanning M with unique finite linear expansions.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The existential witness must be a full real basis of Fin 1 → Real; it cannot be merely an arbitrary vector family or the zero vector.

dependency_coverage.name: Module.Basis.instFunLike
dependency_coverage.meaning: Treats a basis b as its indexed vector family, taking index i to the inverse coordinate representation of the finitely supported vector with value 1 at i and 0 elsewhere.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The vector occurring in each eigenvector equation is the actual basis vector b(p).

dependency_coverage.name: NonUnitalCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocCommRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: Forgets the required associative-ring structure while retaining the underlying nonunital ring operations and commutativity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Participates in supplying the weaker arithmetic interface needed by matrix-vector multiplication; the operations remain real operations.

dependency_coverage.name: NonUnitalNonAssocCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the nonunital, nonassociative ring structure by forgetting commutativity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Further supplies the real arithmetic interface used by matrix-vector multiplication without changing its meaning.

dependency_coverage.name: NonUnitalNonAssocRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring
dependency_coverage.meaning: Retains addition, zero, multiplication, distributivity, and zero multiplication from a nonunital, nonassociative ring.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides precisely the weaker structure accepted by Matrix.mulVec, instantiated using ordinary real addition and multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: Pi.Function.module
dependency_coverage.meaning: Gives functions I → β the pointwise module structure induced by the module structure on β.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The coordinate functions Fin 1 → Real form the real vector space in which the eigenbasis is required.

dependency_coverage.name: Pi.addCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: Gives a function space pointwise addition and zero from the additive commutative monoid structures of its coordinate types.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Vector addition and zero in Fin 1 → Real are coordinatewise.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.commRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: The commutative ring structure on Real with real addition, multiplication, zero, one, negation, subtraction, and natural and integer casts.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Fixes the arithmetic used in the coefficient matrix, matrix-vector product, and scalar-vector equation as real arithmetic.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The inferred additive commutative monoid structure on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies real addition and zero for the vector space and basis structures.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instCommSemiring
dependency_coverage.meaning: The inferred commutative semiring structure on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the real scalar arithmetic needed for the self-algebra and related scalar actions.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.semiring
dependency_coverage.meaning: The inferred semiring structure on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the scalar semiring for real modules and bases.

dependency_coverage.meaning: Makes a semiring a module over itself using multiplication as scalar multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Real coordinates carry their usual real module structure, which induces the coordinate vector-space structure.

dependency_coverage.name: instHSMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Turns an SMul α β operation into an HSMul α β β operation using exactly the same scalar multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Resolves the scalar multiplication in the eigenvector equation to the ordinary pointwise real action.

binders: Universally quantify a real number s, called speed.
For each s, existentially quantify λ : Fin 1 → Real.
For each s and the chosen λ, existentially quantify a basis b of the real vector space Fin 1 → Real, indexed by Fin 1.
For these witnesses, universally quantify p ∈ Fin 1.
conclusions: For every real s there exist λ and b as specified such that [s]b(p) = λ(p)b(p) for every p ∈ Fin 1.
In coordinates, the sole required equation is s · b(0)(0) = λ(0) · b(0)(0), with b(0) a basis vector of the one-dimensional real vector space.
mathematical_definitions: Fin 1 is the singleton index set {0}.
A_s(i,j) = s for every i,j ∈ Fin 1; thus A_s is the 1 × 1 real matrix [s].
The vector space is the real function space Fin 1 → Real with pointwise addition and real scalar multiplication.
A basis is a linearly independent spanning family, so its sole vector here is nonzero.
The matrix property is existence of a basis of real eigenvectors with real eigenvalues, equivalently diagonalizability over the reals.
translation.proposition_plain_english: Every 1 × 1 matrix whose entry is a real number s admits a real eigenbasis. Precisely, for every real s there are a real eigenvalue family λ and a basis b of the one-dimensional real coordinate space such that the matrix [s] sends each basis vector b(p) to λ(p) times that vector. There is only one basis index. The witnesses may depend on s.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The dimension is fixed to 1; the proposition does not quantify over arbitrary matrix sizes or arbitrary real matrices.
The parameter s is unrestricted within Real, including zero and negative values.
The universal eigenvector equation is not vacuous: Fin 1 is nonempty, and the basis requirement forces its sole vector to be nonzero.

The proposition asserts existence of witnesses and does not specify a normalized or canonical basis. The sole eigenvalue necessarily equals s because its basis vector is nonzero, but that equality is not separately written in the target.
There are no conditions about variation of witnesses with s, such as continuity, differentiability, or uniform bounds.
The encoded property concerns only a real matrix and its eigenbasis; it contains no differential equation, solution, initial data, boundary conditions, or time evolution.
